name_input: MEDINEX LABORATORIES PVT LTD; MEDINEX LABORATORIES PVT, LTD
note: RESEARCH INCOMPLETE - no verified risk findings, and no verified negative findings either. Tooling failure: the DuckDuckGo/searx web_search backend returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt; Google and DuckDuckGo HTML endpoints were blocked/timed out; Bing returned the same static cached result set for three different queries (sanctions/court/insolvency, Russia/CIS export, and the plain name query), so it could not be used to confirm or exclude anything. Only primary source read: the company's own website medinex.in (Company Overview page), which self-describes 'Medinex Laboratories is a private limited Indian company, founded by the Chairman Mr. N N Thakkar in 1972', manufacturing adrenaline-based niche APIs (Adrenaline/Epinephrine, Noradrenaline, Isoprenaline, Carbazochrome JP) and speciality chemicals, with a facility commissioned November 2006 at Ukharla, Bhavnagar, Gujarat. This is a self-description only and is NOT evidence of any risk or of any absence of risk. The site's 'Global Presence' page is a dead Flash placeholder (requires Flash Player 9) and contains no country list, so no export destinations - and specifically no Russia/CIS destinations - could be read from it. No OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK or BIS Entity List screening result could be obtained; no Indian court/NCLT/insolvency record could be checked; no credit rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite) could be located; no regulator action (CDSCO, USFDA, ED, GST, SEBI) or dated negative news could be located. All five risk fields are therefore null because nothing is public/verifiable through the tools available in this run - NOT because the company was cleared. Name-collision warning: search results are dominated by unrelated entities sharing the 'Medinex' brand - medinex.com (US medical billing), medinex.health (Malaysian clinic software), medinexhc.com, medinex.pro (Spanish-language clinic software), and Walmart 'MediNex' wheelchair listings. None of these are the Indian API manufacturer and none should be attributed to it. Also note the input record carries two name variants ('PVT LTD' and 'PVT, LTD') and a claimed PAN (AABCM4321L) that I did not verify and did not use, per scope. RECOMMENDATION: re-run this company when the search backend is restored; the risk profile is currently unknown, not clean. Per project rules, absence of a sanctions/court finding is not a rejection ground and this company must not be rejected on this record.
